snippet.title: Woman Simulator Trailer
snippet.description: In the game, you can play the role of a housewife and experience all the household chores for yourself. You will have to cook, wash dishes, iron and dry underwear and socks, vacuum and wash the floor, scrub the toilet and windows. The incentive will be a tyrant husband who will monitor and punish for the inadequate quality of work.
